organization: PUB, Singapore's National Water Agency / National Climate Change Secretariat (NCCS)
region: Singapore (national coastline; City-East Coast, Greater Southern Waterfront, Changi, East Coast)
notes: Page states mean sea level expected to rise up to 1.15 m by 2100 (Third National Climate Change Study), with combined storm surge/high tides up to 5 m; ~30% of the island is less than 5 m above mean sea level. PUB leads whole-of-government coastal and flood resilience; site-specific study for City-East Coast completed in 2025 recommending coastal barriers at Greater Southern Waterfront and raised structures/tidal gates at Changi; 'Long Island' project (announced 2023, ~800 ha reclamation off East Coast); PUB launched the Coastal Protection and Flood Management Research Programme (CFRP) in 2023 and, with NUS, the Coastal Protection and Flood Resilience Institute (CFI) Singapore; new coastal protection legislation and a Code of Practice are being developed. Budget figures: not stated on this page.
recommended_action: Pitch Talaix coastal/flood exposure analytics, monitoring and solutions intelligence to PUB's coastal protection programme and CFI Singapore; position the platform as a data layer for site-specific study follow-ons and the upcoming Code of Practice.
